entries.title: Cross-Functional Decision Brief
entries.intent: Convert ambiguous stakeholder input into a decision-ready brief with explicit tradeoffs and surfaced dissent.
entries.author: Clinton Pracher

entries.title: Launch Readiness Gate Review
entries.intent: Run a pre-ship gate with explicit go, no-go, or defer criteria tied to product risk, not a generic checklist.
entries.author: Clinton Pracher

entries.title: AI Product Governance Review
entries.intent: Review an AI product change for ownership, audit path, trust boundaries, and rollback before it ships.
entries.author: Clinton Pracher

entries.title: Product Operating Model Review
entries.intent: Stress-test or propose changes to product forums, decision rights, and escalation paths without org-chart theater.
entries.author: Clinton Pracher

entries.title: Data Product Readiness Review
entries.intent: Evaluate whether a metric layer, reporting product, or data initiative is decision-ready for leadership use.
entries.author: Clinton Pracher

entries.title: Portfolio Investment Prioritization Brief
entries.intent: Rank portfolio initiatives against shared capacity, budget, and strategic constraints with explicit tradeoffs.
entries.author: Clinton Pracher

entries.title: Canonical Write Authority Review
entries.intent: Name a single canonical writer per task before agents or automations mutate shared records, with collision detection and audit separation.
entries.author: Clinton Pracher
